item.title: Numerous trip hazards made from mud ramps made by kids for bike riding in woods, 20th October
item.description:
Over the last weekend numerous tree stumps have been buried on most of the paths in the woods to create ramps for bikes to speed and jump over. Tree branches have been ripped down to achieve this in one place. Many of the stumps have been covered in mud which makes the ground uneven for walkers. Anti social behaviour by groups of youths on bikes has been reported in Bexley Woods. These woods are a community resource for all and should not be used and abused in this anti social manner.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 34, West Woodside, Albany Park, Greater London
